messages:
sam: Thinking about a super-casual rooftop hang next Friday — ice cream scoops + records + low-key spritzers. 'Sundown Scoops' idea. 7pm start?
priya: love this. can we have a vegan option? :)
mike: i'm in. can bring a bluetooth speaker and a couple of crates of vinyl. got some Motown + 90s alt.
elena: yay. curious about capacity — do we need to reserve the rooftop or sign something?
janet: Janet (facilities) — rooftop is ok but need to log it with me. i'll reserve 6:30–9:30 if you folks confirm headcount. also note noise curfew at 9pm.
sam: good call @janet — thx. i'll make a quick RSVP thread. 7pm still sounding good? 6:30 would give more chill time.
jordan: 6:30 works better for me. earlier is great.
carmen: 6:30 works. i'll bring charcuterie-ish snacks (and a big jar of pickles bc i'm predictable).
mike: bringing a small record player too (battery-powered). anyone have a backup extension cord?
elena: i can bring one. and i've got a vegan ice cream pint from a local place.
priya: i'll bring spritz mixers (non-alc options too) + cups. also allergic to tree nuts fyi — maybe label snacks?
sam: noted — labels for allergies. can everyone add a quick thumbs-up if coming? react or reply here.
office-bot: Poll created: "Sundown Scoops RSVP" — Yes/Maybe/No. (use reactions)
priya: yes :thumbsup:
mike: yes :thumbsup:
elena: yes :thumbsup:
jordan: yes :thumbsup:
carmen: yes :thumbsup:
sam: cool. looks like a small group. janet — please reserve 6:30–9:30.
janet: done, reserved. please keep music at conversational levels near the edge of the roof. i'll bring a rolling cart for food + a small trash can.
mike: perfect. any strong dislikes for records? i'll avoid anything too loud.
priya: no heavy metal pls unless it's an ironic one-off :grin:
elena: can we have a fallback plan if it rains? main kitchen or 6th floor lounge?
janet: fallback to main kitchen (1st floor) reserved if rain. i'll update the event channel if i move it.
sam: i'll create a calendar invite with location and notes (vegan, nut labels, 6:30 start). who wants to co-host so i can add you as organizer?
carmen: happy to co-host.
jordan: can help with setup.
sam: perfect — i'll tag Carmen and Jordan in the invite. thanks all! :party-parrot:
elena: Ooh party parrot. bringing a tiny string of battery lights too.
priya: can't wait. also anyone interested in a quick 10-min 'throwback hit' request list? we can do a tiny playlist.
mike: do it. i'll add a collaborative playlist link in the invite.
office-bot: Calendar event created: "Sundown Scoops — Rooftop" Fri 6:30–9:30. Organizer: sam.
sam: RSVP thread closed for planning — if you didn't sign up and want to drop by, ping me.
